title: [self-tests/helpers] utcDayKey: characterization test for the UTC day key helper
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceAI-Workspace

add a characterization test for utcDayKey in peaceai/self-tests/helpers/dates.ts: utc day keys
- utcDayKey(new Date("2026-10-17T05:59:00Z")) is "2026-10-17"
- utcDayKey(new Date("2026-12-31T23:59:59Z")) is "2026-12-31"
- utcDayKey(new Date("2024-02-29T00:00:00Z")) is "2024-02-29"

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). The existing helpers test checks one mid-day value only; this pins the UTC day boundary, year end and a leap day. Self-zone task on PeaceAI-Workspace: one new peaceai/self-tests/helpers/*.test.ts file only. No gate, grading, approval, leak, rule or workflow file is touched. A box dry-run on PeaceAI-Workspace c7ba0a5 (Node 22) built no candidate: test_target_signature on v1 and v2 (Date parameter); filed only once a Date-argument skill is approved. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
